IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'ACCOUNT_DEP') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.ACCOUNT_DEP;
END;

WITH ACCOUNT_SK
AS(
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(AccountSk),0) RN FROM DW.DIMACCOUNT 

)

SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM ACCOUNT_SK) AS AccountSK
,BCA.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,BCA.CustomerAccountName AS AccountName
,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate AS AccountOpenedDate
--,BCAS.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AS AccountStatus
,CASE
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' AND BCA.CustomerAccountClosedDate <= getdate() AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA') 
     THEN 'Closed'
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'N' AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('CAA', 'SBA') 
     THEN BDAS.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' AND BCA.CustomerAccountClosedDate > getdate() AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('CAA', 'SBA') 
     THEN BDAS.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' AND BCA.CustomerAccountClosedDate > getdate() AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('TDA') 
     THEN  BDAS.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'N' AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('TDA') 
     THEN BDAS.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
     END AS AccountStatus 
,CASE 
     WHEN BCAF.FINANCIALPRODUCTID IN ('00013','01013') OR BCCA.EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator = 'Y' 
     THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PayrollIndicator
,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode AS CurrencyCode
,BCCC.ProfitCostCenterId AS ProfitCostCode
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBRAN.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,BCA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
INTO DW.ACCOUNT_DEP
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId,CustomerAccountName,CustomerAccountOpenedDate,CustomerAccountClosedDate,IsoCurrencyCode,SourceSystemCode,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,BRANCHID FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount where SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' ) BCA 
JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct BCAF ON convert(varchar,BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID) = convert(varchar,BCAF.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID) AND BCAF.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode  AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId AND (BCAF.PERIODENDDATE IS NULL OR BCAF.PERIODENDDATE = '1900-01-01' )
LEFT JOIN DW.FINPRODAPP FPA ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAF.ProductId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,FPA.FinancialProductId) AND BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCAF.SourceSystemCode = FPA.SourceSystemCode
--LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTFINANCIALPRODUCT BCAF ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCAF.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CoreCustomerAccount BCCACCT ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCACCT.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCACCT.FinancialInstitutionId  AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCACCT.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN BNKM.DepositAccountStatus BDAS ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BDAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BDAS.FinancialInstitutionId AND BDAS.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL
LEFT JOIN DW.CORECUSTACCPYROLL BCCA ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = BCCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = DDB.BANKID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBRAN ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDBRAN.BRANCHID AND DDBRAN.CurrentIndicator = 1 
LEFT JOIN DW.CoreCustAccProCostCenter BCCC ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCC.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCC.SourceSystemCode AND BCCC.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1'
WHERE BCA.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
AND BCAF.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')
